step.name: Web component
step.description: The custom element this channel renders, and the ES module that defines it.

parameter.name: webComponent.tagName
parameter.label: web.component.tag.name
parameter.description: Name of the custom element; it must contain a hyphen.

parameter.name: webComponent.moduleUrl
parameter.label: web.component.module.url
parameter.description: The ES module that defines the element: the name of a module bundled with uPortal, an absolute http(s) URL, or a path that starts with /.

parameter.name: webComponent.attributes
parameter.label: web.component.attributes
parameter.description: Attributes to set on the element, one attribute-name=value per line. The portal sets locale, window-state, context-path, fname, csrf-header and csrf-token itself.

parameter.name: webComponent.preferenceAttributes
parameter.label: web.component.preference.attributes
parameter.description: Portlet preferences to pass as attributes, one attribute-name=preferenceName per line. A value the user saved wins over the value set here.

step.name: Preferences
step.description: Preferences of the channel, passed to the element through the preference attributes above.
